topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I always thought chatting online was just a window into another world, a place where anything could happen, far from my own front door. When I saw the city name, it felt like a window crashing through the glass, shattering the neat divide I’d carefully crafted. I hesitated for a long time before I replied, my fingers hovering over the keys, the silence almost deafening. What if this changes everything? What if it’s too much, too real? The boundaries I built, they seemed so strong, but now they feel fragile, like they might give way at any moment. I don’t know if I’m ready for this.
